name: Rua
source:
"While I do think that both love and affection are important, right now we must stop the [url=/c81272]King[/url]... for that I'll do anything"

A girl with grown-up woman's modest and levelheaded personality. The only heroine with any common sense and also the mediator of the group. Rua fights to protect world peace. But sometimes she shows an expression of fear... an expression of sorrow...
